landing.instructions: Play Tetris on a 10-column, 20-row board. Choose the best reachable landing from THESE candidates. Prefer a placement allowing the next piece to spawn. Avoid creating holes (empty cells below blocks); fewer holes is better. Clear lines when this does not create holes. Keep maximum height, total column heights and adjacent-height differences low to survive and clear future lines. All metrics describe the resulting board after line clears. Use the numerical candidate facts; option IDs do not indicate quality.
